input.quote: 14.2 Upon creation and subject to payment of the applicable Fees, Customer owns each Deliverable created specifically for Customer. Vendor hereby assigns to Customer all worldwide right, title, and interest in those Deliverables and shall obtain equivalent assignments from its personnel.
input.rationale:
The IP package meets the preferred position. Section 14.2 vests Deliverables in Customer with an express Vendor assignment and further-assurances covenant; 14.1 confirms Customer owns all Customer Data, Customer Confidential Information and independently developed IP, with only a limited processing right to Vendor (no assignment of our IP or data). Vendor retains only Vendor Technology (1.9, expressly excluding Customer Data and pre-existing Customer IP), and 14.3 routes embedded Vendor Technology to the Section 13.2 perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to use, modify, create derivative works and have contractors support it for Customer's business. Section 14.4 negates joint ownership absent a signed instrument setting exploitation rights, and feedback use is limited to generalized suggestions with Customer retaining unrestricted rights. Section 15.1 further bars sale, advertising use, commingling and model training on Customer Data. No redline needed.</parationale>
